author: David Miller, CPA (Corporate Controller)
post_title: Why unapplied cash persists at mid-market B2B companies
full_body_excerpt: At $30M-$80M ARR, remittance advice comes in via every conceivable channel: lockbox checks, EDI 820, bank email attachments, customer vendor portals. ERP auto-reconciliation breaks down, leaving hundreds of unapplied cash balances at month-end.
recommended_advisory_angle: Acknowledge their General ERP / Accounting friction regarding Unapplied Cash. Share non-pitch advisory perspective on deterministic CSV/API journal matching logic.

author: Sarah Jenkins (VP Finance)
post_title: The month-end close bottleneck: Unapplied cash and bank exceptions
full_body_excerpt: Closing the books takes 8 days instead of 3 primarily because the AR team is tracking down who paid what. If the payment reference doesn't match an open invoice in Sage Intacct or NetSuite, it sits in limbo.
recommended_advisory_angle: Acknowledge their Netsuite friction regarding Unapplied Cash. Share non-pitch advisory perspective on deterministic CSV/API journal matching logic.
